_note: Frozen on 2026-10-03: 13 dev, 27 test (40 Tier A scenarios). dev = prompt and checkpoint selection; test = final runs only (doc 11 §3). dev grew from 10 to 13 on 2026-10-01: its -02 scenarios were used to check the fragment context (files over 60 lines), so they cannot be test.
